description: Invalid pacs.008 message missing the required GrpHdr (Group Header) element. This message should fail XSD schema validation as GrpHdr is a mandatory element in pacs.008.001.10.
test_coverage: XSD schema validation for mandatory elements
Parser error handling for missing required elements
business_rules_expected_to_fail: PACS008-GH01: Message ID present (fails - GrpHdr missing entirely)
PACS008-GH02: Transaction count matches (fails - GrpHdr missing entirely)

expected_errors.explanation: The GrpHdr (Group Header) element is mandatory in pacs.008.001.10 according to the ISO 20022 XSD schema. It must contain MsgId, CreDtTm, NbOfTxs, and agent information.

missing_elements.impact: Without GrpHdr, the message lacks critical metadata including message identifier, creation timestamp, transaction count, and routing information. This makes the message unparseable and unprocessable.

notes: This test validates that parsers correctly reject messages missing mandatory top-level elements. The GrpHdr element is required by the pacs.008.001.10 XSD schema and contains essential metadata for message routing and processing. Any conformant parser must fail when processing this message.
